# SkyRoads SDL Complete Edition

SkyRoads SDL is a native, cross-platform bundle of SkyRoads, the 1993 DOS space racer by Bluemoon Interactive.

It includes the original SkyRoads, SkyRoads Xmas Special, and Bluemoon's original track editor. The project rewrites the original source code in portable C with SDL2 so the games run natively on macOS, Linux, and Windows without DOSBox or emulation. It preserves the original fixed-point physics, ports the hand-written x86 road renderer, and includes AdLib FM synthesis plus an optional wavetable soundtrack mode.

Official site: https://pedrocatalao.github.io/skyroads-sdl/
Source code: https://github.com/pedrocatalao/skyroads-sdl
Latest releases: https://github.com/pedrocatalao/skyroads-sdl/releases/latest

## Downloads

- macOS universal app: https://github.com/pedrocatalao/skyroads-sdl/releases/latest/download/skyroads-macos-universal.zip
- Linux x86_64 tarball: https://github.com/pedrocatalao/skyroads-sdl/releases/latest/download/skyroads-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
- Linux ARM64 tarball: https://github.com/pedrocatalao/skyroads-sdl/releases/latest/download/skyroads-linux-arm64.tar.gz
- Windows x86_64 zip: https://github.com/pedrocatalao/skyroads-sdl/releases/latest/download/skyroads-windows-x86_64.zip
- Windows ARM64 zip: https://github.com/pedrocatalao/skyroads-sdl/releases/latest/download/skyroads-windows-arm64.zip

## Key Facts

- Platforms: macOS, Linux, Windows
- Language and libraries: C, SDL2
- Distribution: self-contained downloads with freeware game data, the Xmas Special, the track editor, and SDL2 bundled
- License and rights: unofficial fan port; SkyRoads and SkyRoads Xmas Special game content belongs to Bluemoon Interactive
- Controls: arrow keys steer and accelerate or brake, Space jumps, P pauses, X switches between SkyRoads and SkyRoads Xmas Special from the main menu, E opens the track editor, F9 switches music mode, F10 toggles CRT effects, F11 or Cmd-F toggles fullscreen
